# BETTOR PROFITABILITY STACK V1 — ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT

## Global
- Research/PAPER-SHADOW only.
- No credentials or external writes.
- No submit/cancel/funding authority.
- SMALL LIVE remains SHADOW.
- Historical PAPER records immutable.
- No profitability claim from synthetic tests.

## Execution Truth
PASS requires:
- costs explicitly decomposed
- fill probability measured
- maker EV conditional on fill
- adverse selection measured after fills
- lower-bound EV, not mean-only
- MAKE/TAKE/WAIT/REFUSE can return REFUSE

## Structural Arb
PASS requires:
- settlement state space explicit
- every state payoff verified
- all-in cost includes fees/slippage
- depth/capacity bound
- no label-only equivalence
- guarantee survives every modeled settlement state

## Digital Twin
PASS requires:
- chronological event replay
- strategy view contains no future state
- submit/cancel latency
- partial fills
- queue-ahead treatment
- settlement
- actual production decision logic can be wrapped without changing it

## Profitability Governor
PASS requires:
- independent event-level denominator
- repeated decisions separately reported
- time-uniform lower bound
- minimum forward evidence
- calibration + execution + settlement + capacity gates
- no positive recipient => CASH

## P&L Attribution
PASS requires:
- expected and realized profit
- execution residual
- management residual
- settlement residual
- outcome variance
- exact reconciliation within declared tolerance
- aggregates by sport/family/regime/venue/strategy

## Production eligibility
This package alone never authorizes live capital.
Any later live activation must pass the existing BETTOR production release and
risk-control process.
